Create one or more Kubernetes resources from a YAML manifest

Source: R/utils.R
create_from_yaml.Rd

Accepts a path or a character string containing one or more YAML documents (separated by ---). Each document is routed to the correct endpoint via the DynamicClient. Mirrors kubernetes.utils.create_from_yaml.

Usage

create_from_yaml(
  client,
  yaml_file = NULL,
  yaml_string = NULL,
  namespace = "default"
)

Arguments

client

An ApiClient.

yaml_file

Path to a YAML file; mutually exclusive with yaml_string.

yaml_string

A character string of YAML content.

namespace

Default namespace for namespaced resources that don't specify one. Defaults to "default".

Value

A list of server responses, one per document.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
client <- new_client_from_config()
create_from_yaml(client, yaml_file = "manifest.yaml")
} # }
